summary: The prepared source already detects DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 routed experts as packed FP4 and routes an H20/SM90 non-A2A launch to flashinfer_mxfp4. The legacy FP8 route reproduces the reported Hidden size mismatch because checkpoint hidden_size=4096 but packed I8 expert weights have physical K=2048.

tests.what_was_measured: On gfx950, the actual production fused_experts_impl shape gate rejected the 0731 packed shape on the legacy FP8 route, accepted it on the FP4 route, accepted a true-FP8 boundary, and rejected malformed FP4. Kernel preparation was intercepted after the shape checks.
Six deterministic cases covered packed I8 detection, true FP8, missing metadata, remote path, H20/SM90 MXFP4 selection, and the true-FP8 H20 boundary.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-4d0012c4c996/venv/bin/python -c 'from sglang.srt.configs.deepseek_v4 import try_detect_fp4_experts; assert try_detect_fp4_experts("/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-4d0012c4c996/dsv4-header-fixture") is True'
tests.what_was_measured: Current source classified the range-fetched real DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 safetensors shard header as packed FP4.
Existing test is host-platform-sensitive on gfx950: its SM100 mock leaves is_hip=true, so the NVIDIA-only branch is skipped. A complete NVIDIA mock passes in the report-specific regression.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 ran production fused_experts_impl shape checks; see reproduce_hidden_size_route.log. No CUDA/H20 kernel execution is claimed.
remaining_limitations: The reported NVIDIA H20/SM90 hardware was unavailable; the assigned GPU was gfx950.
The 166,878,536,440-byte DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were not downloaded, so full model loading and HTTP serving were not reproduced.
FlashInfer MXFP4 CUDA execution, semantic accuracy, and distributed TP/EP behavior remain unverified.
The issue omitted launch flags and TP/EP configuration, and the cited image suffix e4c4faf8 was not a fetchable public commit.
